entities.summary: Andreea Ehritt-Vanc is a Romanian former professional tennis player. Vanc played predominantly in doubles, and won two WTA Tour titles. Her best performance at the major tournaments is third round: at the 2005 Australian Open and the 2005 French Open. She achieved her career-high rank of No. 40 on 8 May 2006.
